# allofus.one

> A free 3D world for connecting humanity, playable in any web browser (phone, laptop, WebXR headsets). People make an avatar, set a status ring, walk "life paths," meet others on the same paths, trade items and services in Global Match, plan their lives on a personal Lifeboard dashboard, and claim free land to build a home.

## What you can do
- Avatar: pick a character and optionally add your face from a selfie (the photo stays on the device).
- Status rings: Home (gold), Hanging (green, open to chat), Working (blue, collab invites only), Exploring (orange), Do Not Disturb (gray).
- Life paths: Business, Learning, Wellness, Adventure, Causes, Creativity, Explore. Each leads to a district (City, Library, Waterfall, Desert, Starport + Orbit Garden, Art Garden, the Bay).
- Connect flow: wave, connect request, chat unlocks on mutual yes; message requests from strangers; public rooms and collab rooms; meeting requests (call, meeting, VR visit).
- Lifeboard: life-balance wheel, goal stacker, vision board flowchart, wellness habits and mood, projects and booking link, giving, creative links, custom buttons.
- Global Match: I Have / I Need for items and services only. No money changes hands on allofus.one.
- Land: open lots along roads that continue without end; home styles include Eco Deco, Bungalow, Beach Villa, Treehouse, Space Villa, Loft Apartment and Cliffside Mansion.
- Feed: newest first from people the user chooses; no ranking algorithm.
- Lifeboard tools (all free, private): Today (daily affirmation that does not loop, top 3, streak), Life Dash (every tool on one screen), focus timer, trackers with charts, reminders that export to phone calendars (.ics), journal, sealed letters to future you, money calculators (50/30/20 budget, snowball vs avalanche debt payoff, savings goal, compound growth, emergency fund), hugs, halo sign.
- Everyone sees each player's real avatar: same character, colors, body type (regular, slim, muscle, sumo, comic big-head, tall, mini), clothing extras and optional selfie face.
- Hugs: send hearts to any player in-world, or email a hug card link to anyone.
- Halo sign: a glowing line of text that floats above an avatar (mood, cause, what they are looking for, or a pinned affirmation).
- Friend scan: matches by life paths and causes; teens only with teens, adults only with adults.
- Weather control (personal view): clear, golden hour, rain, thunderstorm, snow, fog, northern lights, tropical sky, night.
- Worlds globe: a spinning directory linking World VR Mall, Comics Come Alive, The VR Galaxy, Another Dimension VR, Virtual Reality Adventure, VR Flying Simulator, Sparkle Diner, USA Business Search, CO Business List and more.
- Places: No. 1 Unity Road (Zach's net-zero model home: waterfalls, gallery, 360 Dream Room, elevator office, roof pool, backyard rocket), 8 Silk Lane (a spider field guide with 16 species and scientific names), Comic Lane (Captain Kapow and Comics Come Alive).
- Home builder: shape (rectangle, L, U, courtyard, round tower), 1 to 3 floors, wall materials, roof types (flat, gable, hip, shed, butterfly, dome, living garden) and roof materials (slate, standing-seam aluminum, clay tile, cedar shake, copper, solar glass, living green), pools you draw yourself with depth and fish, gardens with growing flowers, solar, wind, fences, signs, mailbox styles and Lifeblocks (build anything block by block). Live 3D preview.
- Addresses: every home gets a street address and a unique hashed address code (SHA-256 fingerprint). Share links like https://allofus.one/?to=CODE walk visitors to the door.
- Directory: a phone-book of every place and every home address, searchable, linked to the map.
- Voice chat: real peer-to-peer WebRTC audio rooms (nearby, plaza, conference hall and more); teens only with teens, adults only with adults; never recorded.
- Conference Center: 72 seats and a 26 m screen; present PDFs, PowerPoint, Word, MP3, video, images, YouTube or web pages live to everyone in the hall.
- Coburn's Place: a mountain mansion reached by a chairlift, with a timed ski-run game (gates, coins, personal best), a swimmable pool with a coin dive and a winter/summer season switch.
- Living gardens: Colorado blue columbines, moth orchids, giant alliums, sunflowers, tulips, lupines and bird of paradise that grow and bloom, visited by ruby-throated hummingbirds.
- Lifeboard Insights: activity heatmap, life-balance radar, goal and bucket-list donuts, focus, mood, habit and tracker charts. Plus Events (host conferences with invite links and calendar files) and a Bucket list.
- Lumi: a scripted guide (not AI) that never pops open on its own.
- Family friendly with no exceptions: language filter, report and block, accounts 13+.

## New in October 2026 (v5)
- No. 1 Unity Road rebuilt as layered, angled architecture: a twisted terracotta wing with the Disco Room (LED dance floor, disco ball, beat), a charcoal cantilever with a green roof, stepped glass terraces and a living green wall.
- Rain-to-tap water demo: copper gutters and rain chains → 2,500-gallon tank → sediment, carbon, reverse-osmosis and UV filters → drinking water, showers, an organic garden and a koi rain pond. Pipes light up blue step by step.
- Unity Links Sky Range: a floating driving range with six clubs, power meter, wind, five target greens, bullseyes, a 3D scoreboard, ball-cam and VR trigger swings.
- Character Studio: full-screen editor with live 3D preview; Zach characters with his real face; ant and spider; Elvis, surfer, afro and rainbow hair; hippie, tie-dye, disco and glow outfits; noodle limbs; shrink-to-ant mode.
